summary.name: Synthesia
summary.one_liner: Synthesia is a business AI video platform that generates videos with AI avatars, voiceovers, and translations from text, documents, or links.
use_cases: translate and dub videos into many languages
summary.what_it_does: Synthesia creates AI videos with stock or custom avatars, voiceovers, and scenes; users can start from a prompt, PowerPoint, document, or link. Videos can be generated in 140+ languages, and existing videos can be translated or dubbed with AI Dubbing, optionally with lip sync and a custom glossary. Teams can manage content with Brand Kits, roles and approvals, and shared workspaces, and publish via shareable link, embed, or SCORM for an LMS, with edits updating automatically. The platform also offers Interactive Avatars for roleplay and survey sessions, plus APIs for generating videos and embedding real-time avatars in products.
notable: Interactive Avatars for real-time roleplay and survey sessions with scoring and themes
Personal Avatar from a photo or video, with a required on-camera consent recording
SCORM export and LMS embedding with auto-updating edits
SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR compliance with EU data residency
caveats: Free Basic plan includes only 500 credits a month (about 10 minutes of video), and paid plans are needed for more
Personal Avatar creation requires a live on-camera consent recording
